name: shipwelldev/cornerstone
description: A highly opinionated Laravel Livewire starter kit by Ship Well Development.

configure-boost: @php -r "if (! file_exists('boost.json')) { exit(0); } \$config = json_decode(file_get_contents('boost.json'), true); if (! is_array(\$config)) { fwrite(STDERR, 'Unable to configure Boost because boost.json is invalid.' . PHP_EOL); exit(1); } foreach (['packages' => 'pestphp/pest-plugin-agent', 'skills' => 'pest-plugin-agent'] as \$key => \$value) { \$values = \$config[\$key] ?? []; if (! is_array(\$values)) { fwrite(STDERR, 'Unable to configure Boost because [' . \$key . '] is invalid.' . PHP_EOL); exit(1); } \$values[] = \$value; \$config[\$key] = array_values(array_unique(\$values)); } ksort(\$config); if (file_put_contents('boost.json', json_encode(\$config, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) . PHP_EOL) === false) { fwrite(STDERR, 'Unable to write boost.json.' . PHP_EOL); exit(1); } putenv('PARATEST=1'); passthru(escapeshellarg(PHP_BINARY) . ' artisan boost:update --ansi --no-interaction', \$exitCode); exit(\$exitCode);"
prepare-environment: @php -r "\$environment = file_get_contents('.env'); if (\$environment === false || preg_match('/^APP_KEY=.+$/m', \$environment) !== 1) { passthru(escapeshellarg(PHP_BINARY) . ' artisan key:generate --ansi --no-interaction', \$exitCode); exit(\$exitCode); }"
install-boost: @php -r "\$nonInteractive = filter_var(getenv('COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION'), FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOL); if (file_exists('boost.json')) { exit(0); } if (\$nonInteractive || ! stream_isatty(STDIN)) { fwrite(STDOUT, PHP_EOL . 'Boost setup was skipped because Composer is running non-interactively.' . PHP_EOL . 'Run composer setup in an interactive terminal to finish setup.' . PHP_EOL); exit(0); } passthru(escapeshellarg(PHP_BINARY) . ' artisan boost:install --ansi', \$exitCode); exit(\$exitCode);"
dev: npx concurrently -c "#93c5fd,#c4b5fd,#fb7185,#fdba74" "php artisan serve" "php artisan queue:listen --tries=1 --timeout=0" "php artisan pail --timeout=0" "npm run dev" --names=server,queue,logs,vite --kill-others
